faq: Do I need a paid search app?
Many platforms have good built in predictive search. We start there. If your catalog or needs call for a paid app, we explain the cost and the benefit before installing anything.
Common typos and word variants can be handled on Standard and Premium. The exact power depends on your search tool, and we tell you what is possible before we start.
How do you choose the synonyms?
From your product names, tags and the search terms shoppers use. If your store has search history, we use it. Otherwise we draft from your catalog and you approve the list.
Will suggestions show hidden or old products?
No. We exclude hidden, draft and out of stock products where your tool allows. We test searches for items you have retired, so shoppers do not land on dead ends.

desc:
Product search suggestions as you type help shoppers reach the right item after two or three letters. Ecom Swift LLC sets up predictive search with images and prices, tunes it with your own synonyms and tests it using real searches from your store.

## Why store search deserves attention

Shoppers who use search usually know what they want. They are close to buying, and a poor result sends them away. If someone types "trainers" and your products say "sneakers", an untuned search returns nothing, and the store looks like it does not stock the item.

Search is often the least polished part of a store, because it works well enough in a demo. Real shoppers misspell, abbreviate and use words that the product titles never contain.

## What is predictive search?

Predictive search shows matching products, collections and popular queries in a drop down while the shopper types. It usually includes small images and prices, so the shopper can choose without loading a results page. Many store platforms include a basic version, and apps can extend it.

## How search quality affects shopping

Good suggestions shorten the path. A visitor types a few letters, sees the product and clicks it. Fewer steps mean fewer chances to give up. Popular search lists also help people who are not sure what to type, because they show what others look for.

Failed searches reveal demand too. If many people search for something you do not list, or list under another name, that is useful to know. We include a report of top and failed terms in the top package, so you can add synonyms or products. Outcomes vary with your catalog and traffic, so we measure rather than promise.

## What a well-tuned search includes

- Predictive suggestions that appear after a few letters.
- Products and collections in the drop down.
- Images and prices shown in each result.
- Synonym pairs written from your customers' own words, such as sneakers and trainers.
- Handling of common typos and plural forms.
- A list of popular searches shown when the box is empty.
- A plan for searches that return nothing, such as showing best sellers.
- Filters on the results page.
- A clear rule that hides draft, archived or old products.
- A check on phones, where the drop down must fit the screen.

## How we do it

We start by reading your current search behavior and your catalog. We collect the words customers use, from your emails, reviews, support chats and any search data you can share. Then we turn on or configure predictive search and style the drop down to match your theme.

Next we write synonym pairs and typo rules and test real searches from your store. We try short words, long phrases, brand names, colors and misspellings. Anything that returns a poor result gets fixed or recorded.

Basic covers predictive search with images and prices. Standard adds synonyms, typo handling, a popular searches list and a test of real queries. Premium adds more synonyms, a plan for empty results, filters, a search report and a period of ongoing tuning.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Use the words your customers use.
- Test searches on a phone.
- Keep synonyms in a shared list.
- Review failed searches regularly.
- Hide products you no longer sell.

**Avoid:**
- Adding hundreds of synonyms without testing.
- Showing sold out products first.
- Leaving the no results page blank.
- Letting search show hidden or old items.
- Copying another store's synonym list unchanged.

## Who this is for

This service suits stores with a large or varied catalog, stores where customers use regional words for the same item and stores that see many searches with no clicks. It also suits owners who suspect that search is losing sales but have no data yet.

## What we need from you

Share any search terms you know customers use, and note any products that must never appear. Tell us whether you use a paid search app. Give us collaborator, staff or developer access, and never send a password. We confirm what we plan to change first.
